modal.title: Switch to {name}, the free option?
modal.lead: The free option costs the site nothing, but it is less reliable for rules questions. Here is the difference:
modal.c1: Reads the whole rulebook, including pages with diagrams
modal.c2: Cites the exact pages its answer comes from
modal.c3: Better at tricky edge cases and rule interactions
modal.f2: Only reads the rulebook's text (not images) and the pages that seem relevant
modal.f3: More likely to get a rule wrong or invent one — double-check in the rulebook
modal.f4: Questions go to an outside free service whose terms may allow using them to improve its models
modal.tip: Tip: for a quick reminder the free option is fine; for a rules dispute at the table, use Claude or check the rulebook.

picker.b2: Filters: players, length, level, party game, kind of game…
picker.b3: Random draw from your own list.

install.lead: The site installs like a real app, no app store needed: an icon on your screen, and it opens full screen.

ios.title: Install on iPhone or iPad
ios.b2: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).

android.title: Install on Android
android.b1: Open the site in Chrome (or Samsung Internet).
android.b2: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.

desktop.title: Install on your computer
desktop.b1: Open the site in Edge or Chrome (Windows, Mac or Linux).
desktop.b2: Click the install icon at the end of the address bar, or open the menu (⋯ or ⋮).
desktop.b3: Choose “Install Rendezvous Ludique” (or “Create shortcut”, tick “Open as window”): it shows up in the Start menu and the taskbar.
